user.title: Connect to your Deco
user.description: Use the address of the main Deco (the gateway), and the TP-Link ID email and password that own the Deco (the account you sign in to the Deco app with). Blocking goes through the Deco app's own channel, which signs in with that email.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to your Deco again
reauth_confirm.description: Enter the TP-Link ID email and password that own the Deco. Deco Guard needs the email to block devices, and this is also asked for when the Deco rejects the stored login. Polling has stopped so the account isn't locked out.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the Deco (or it isn't the main node).
error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check the password. The Deco locks the account after repeated failures.
error.invalid_tmp_auth: The Deco accepted the password but not the TP-Link ID email. Use the account that owns the Deco. Repeated failures lock the account.

data.scan_interval: Poll interval (seconds). New devices are blocked within one interval.
